conflicts.permit: We maintain limited information on the basis of our legitimate interest: we keep customer care records and supporting data as well as imprecise location of download/purchase for five years to support our customer care decisions, enforce our rights and enable us to defend ourselves in the event of a claim, profile data for one year in anticipation of potential litigation, for the establishment, exercise or defense of legal claims, and data necessary to prevent users who were banned or people who were found to be under the age of 18 from opening a new account, to ensure the safety and vital interests of our users.
conflicts.prohibit: We do not permit individuals under the age of 18 on our platform.
conflicts.situation: Processing or storing personal information of individuals who are under the age of 18 on the platform.
conflicts.reason: The policy completely bars individuals under 18 from the platform, yet explicitly specifies retaining data of individuals under 18 to prevent new account creation without reconciling the collection/existence of such data.
